# The bundled textures

Each bundled skin tiles one texture in its page background. All four tiles are
**computed, not drawn, photographed or generated by a model**: a script in this
repository writes each one from fixed numbers, so there is no image source or
licence to credit, the same command writes the same file, and every layer of every
tile is periodic, so it repeats without a seam. (How a skin declares and uses a
texture, and what the plugin checks, is in [AUTHORING.md](AUTHORING.md) and
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).)

| Skin | Tile | Size | What it is | Script |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Terran | `skins/terran/textures/plate.png` | 64 x 64 | Tread ("diamond") plate: raised lozenges in a 2 x 2 pattern of alternating 45 degree angles, lit from the top left | `scripts/make-textures.py plate` |
| Protoss | `skins/protoss/textures/crystal.png` | 256 x 256 | Angular crystal facets, each a slightly different shade, with pale edges and a few gold ones | `scripts/make-textures.py crystal` |
| Zerg | `skins/zerg/textures/creep.png` | 256 x 256 | Cellular tissue in plum and magenta with a network of veins and bright nodes | `scripts/make-creep.py` |
| (example) | `waves` | 256 x 128 | Faint ripples on water; Corpo Blue uses it | `scripts/make-textures.py waves` |

```
python scripts/make-textures.py plate   skins/terran/textures/plate.png   --preview
python scripts/make-textures.py crystal skins/protoss/textures/crystal.png --preview
python scripts/make-textures.py waves   path/to/waves.png                  --preview
python scripts/make-creep.py            skins/zerg/textures/creep.png      --preview
```

`--preview` also writes a 3 x 3 repetition beside the file, which is the quickest way
to judge the tiling. The scripts need numpy and Pillow (development only; the plugin
never runs them) and write an indexed PNG with no metadata, the form the plugin
requires of a texture that ships in this package (it re-checks each one strictly when
it publishes the skin).

## How the tiles are made

* **Periodic by construction.** Noise is filtered in the frequency domain (periodic
  for free), distortions and distances sample modulo the tile size, and waves use
  whole-number wavelengths.
* **Mostly transparent.** Each tile is a thin overlay (alpha from a few percent up to
  about a third at its brightest) so the skin's own gradients show through and text
  on the page background stays readable.
* **Small.** A 64 x 64 plate is about 1.4 KB; the 256 x 256 tiles are 13 to 17 KB.

## Changing one

Edit the numbers in the script and run it again; the tile and its preview change,
nothing else does. Keep a tile under 64 KB and 256 x 256 px (the limits in
`src/Skin/Limits.php` and `PngTexture`), or the test that checks the bundled tiles
fails.
